title: Rationale
html:
Rationale

The US and Iran sign a nuclear deal with no extensive strikes first

Kalshi asks a deal before July 1, 2027. May 18 is 180 of the 224 days to that deadline, and Kalshi's own ladder puts 0.095 of its 0.205 before March 1, so about three quarters of deals by July land by May 18; of those, I take 0.85 to come without an extensive round of strikes first. 0.75 x 0.85 is about 0.62.
